exposure: Endoscopic cardia peripheral tissue scar formation (ECSF) procedures
cohort: The participants are 1219 patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) who underwent endoscopic antireflux therapy, drawn from twenty included studies.
finding: PECC was found to be significantly superior to RF in lowering postoperative GERD-Q scores and augmenting LES pressures, while ARMI was preferable in reducing AET percentage, with PECC being the most favorable choice overall considering safety and efficacy.
